component.name: SENZO
component.summary: Native media center for Stremio add-ons

description.p: SENZO is a fast, native desktop media center built with Rust and Slint. It connects to the Stremio add-on ecosystem, plays torrents through the bundled streaming server and MPV, and keeps your library and playback progress in a local database.
The interface is a cinematic dark shell with a persistent navigation rail, catalogue shelves, detail pages, search, downloads and a fully native player.
